implementation.warmOn: Chat opens; no model loading on app launch/availability probe

runtimeComparison.method: Same three sequential questions through the production prompt builder and runtime. Baseline recreates and destroys the model per request; revised run retains one private model. Inference executed serially. Results are a small latency sample, not a speed guarantee. Answers are sampled and system memory pressure varies.

What was my practice codeword? Answer with just that word.

audioVerification.limitation: One cumulative fallback/cache miss was observed. This capture does not locate its onset; no claim of zero fallback or physical sound listening.

native.limitations: Muted audio; no physical MIDI or acoustic quality test. High memory pressure: M1 16 GB, about 14.9 GiB swap in use. Native baseline overlapped a unit run, so its latency is retained descriptively, not used as a controlled speed comparison.
